capabilities: publish notes to HackMD or GitHub gist
upload note images to Imgur or HackMD
copy the published URL to the clipboard
save the published URL in note frontmatter
toggle frontmatter and filename H1 in the published note
extras: README recommends HackMD as the provider for most sharing workflows; HackMD images are limited to 1 MB with resizing and JPEG conversion applied when possible.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-command way to publish a single note to an external service and get a shareable URL back into the note.
summary: Note-sharing plugin that publishes notes to HackMD or GitHub gist, uploads images, and writes the published URL back to frontmatter.
